none: PAS FindID 979092: Roman: Vectis Ware Vessel (rim sherd)
contea di ritrovamento: Isle of Wight (Inghilterra e Galles)

A rim sherd of a Roman ceramic cooking pot. This sherd appears to be Vectis Ware but seems to include grog in the tempering which is not usual. The upper face of the everted rim has three parallel transverse inscribed grooves. The sherd was extracted from the cliff face just beneath the topsoil.
